title: Bunny Drop
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At his grandfather's funeral, 30-year-old bachelor Daikichi learns the old man had an illegitimate young daughter, Rin, whom no one in the family wants. On impulse he takes her in himself, and the series follows him learning to raise a child as a single parent. After a time skip the story follows a teenage Rin; database tags (some flagged as spoilers) indicate the relationship between Rin and Daikichi turns romantic.
life_message: Taking responsibility for a child no one else wants, and reshaping one's life around her, is a life well spent.

content.note: Family rejection of a small child (blurb).

(to verify) MU 'Adoptive Father Turned Lover' and AniList spoiler-flagged Age Gap, Heterosexual and Inseki tags point to a romance between Rin and her guardian after the time skip; no plot summary source confirms how it is handled.
